title: Repeat Late Pickups in a Semester: 2026-27 Rate Multiplier, Creek Kids Club Extended Day Program
content:
**Clause.** The board-approved 2026-27 late pickup fee schedule of the Creek Kids Club Extended Day Program sets a repeat multiplier on a chargeable late pickup:

- **200 percent** when the written late-pickup warning for the pickup's semester was issued before the pickup's service date;
- **150 percent** when no such warning was issued before the service date and the pickup is the second or later chargeable late pickup of that semester;
- **the whole rate, 100 percent,** when neither holds.

The semester is the one recorded on the pickup: fall, August 1 through December 31, or spring, January 1 through June 30. The warning and the chargeable late pickups are read from the enrollment's attendance log.

## Condition table

| Warning for the semester issued before the service date | Second or later chargeable late pickup of the semester | Multiplier |
|---|---|---|
| yes | yes | 200 percent |
| yes | no | 200 percent |
| no | yes | 150 percent |
| no | no | 100 percent |

## Points of judgement

- **Waived incidents.** Only chargeable late pickups are counted toward "second or later". A waived first incident is not a chargeable late pickup, so the first chargeable pickup after a waived incident is the first chargeable one of the semester.
- **Same-day warning.** A warning dated the same day as the pickup was not issued before the service date. That pickup falls under the 150 percent or 100 percent row.
- **New semester.** A warning issued in the fall does not cover a spring pickup, because the warning read is the one for the pickup's own semester.

## Examples (hypothetical fall semester)

- First late pickup on a September date: waived first incident.
- Second, in October: the first chargeable pickup, with no warning issued. 100 percent.
- Third, in October: a second chargeable pickup, with no warning issued before its date. 150 percent. The written warning is issued on that date.
- Fourth, in November: the warning was issued before this date. 200 percent.
